summary: The 25% rate applies only to recharges and bill payments for an ACTIVE Airtel Mobile, Airtel Broadband, Airtel WiFi or Airtel DTH connection, paid inside the Airtel Thanks app. Hardware cost, installation charges, an advance recharge or payment, and any payment for a new or inactive Airtel connection are all excluded and earn the ordinary 1% instead.
Utility and telecom bills earn the 10% rate only when they are paid inside the Airtel Thanks app. The same bill paid on any other platform earns no cashback at all.

The 25% Airtel rate and the 10% utility rate are not capped in rupees. In each statement cycle the Airtel cashback is limited to twice the 1% base cashback earned in that same cycle, and the utility cashback to one times it, so a cycle with no eligible base spending pays nothing on either. In practice that means roughly 12.5 times your Airtel spend, and roughly 10 times your utility spend, has to be eligible base spending before you collect the full rate.

The 10% value back at Zomato, Blinkit and District Movies applies only on the partner's own app or website, paid online with the card, with the "Get 10% back using Airtel Axis Credit Card" coupon applied; UPI does not qualify, and Zomato and Blinkit need a minimum order of ₹499. It is capped at ₹200 per partner per month, which is 10% of a ₹2,000 qualifying spend ceiling per partner per month. It is credited to that partner's own wallet after delivery, cannot be moved to your card statement, and those orders do not also earn the card's 1% base cashback.
Base cashback is rounded down on each transaction separately, so ₹1,560 of spending at 1% credits ₹15 rather than ₹15.60.

On the RuPay variant, eligible UPI transactions earn 1% cashback, with no separate UPI cashback cap specified. Eligible Airtel and utility payments made through the Airtel Thanks app may instead earn 25% or 10% respectively.
The 25% Airtel rate applies to eligible recharges and bill payments for an active Airtel Mobile, Airtel Broadband, Airtel WiFi or Airtel DTH connection.
Unlimited 1% base cashback is earned on other eligible spending, and that base cashback is what determines the statement-cycle caps for the 25% Airtel and 10% utility categories.
The annual fee of ₹500 is waived on spending greater than ₹2 lakh in the preceding year; rent and wallet loads are excluded from that calculation.
The 1% fuel-surcharge waiver applies to eligible transactions of ₹400 to ₹4,000, subject to a maximum waiver of ₹500 per statement cycle.

Cashback is not earned on hardware cost, installation charges, advance recharges or payments, payments for new or inactive Airtel connections, EMI transactions, transactions subsequently converted into EMI, cash advances and financial-institution transactions, fuel, rent, wallet recharges, jewellery, insurance, education, government services, utility and telecom payments made outside Airtel Thanks, gift cards, bridge fees, road fees and tolls, outstanding card-balance payments, card fees and other charges, Zomato, Blinkit and District Movies transactions receiving the separate partner-wallet value back, or commercial, business and other non-personal usage.
Co-branded card issued by Axis Bank with Bharti Airtel. The maximum credit limit is ₹5,00,000.
Complimentary domestic airport lounge access has been discontinued on this card.

Worked example for the Airtel cap: ₹25,000 of eligible base spending earns ₹250 of base cashback at 1%, so the Airtel cashback cap for that cycle is 2 × ₹250 = ₹500, and ₹2,000 of eligible Airtel spending can therefore receive the full ₹500 cashback.

Worked example for the utility cap: ₹25,000 of eligible base spending earns ₹250 of base cashback at 1%, so the utility cashback cap for that cycle is ₹250, and ₹2,500 of eligible utility spending can therefore receive the full ₹250 cashback.
Card variant: RuPay Select / Mastercard World / Visa Signature.

fuel.description: 1% fuel-surcharge waiver on eligible transactions of ₹400 to ₹4,000, subject to a maximum waiver of ₹500 per statement cycle. Fuel spends themselves earn no cashback, and a 1% fee applies once cumulative fuel spending reaches ₹50,000 or more in a statement cycle (MCCs 5172, 5541, 5542, 5983).

redemption.notes: ₹1 cashback = ₹1 statement credit. No manual redemption is required, there is no minimum redemption and the redemption fee is nil. Cashback earned during one statement cycle is credited in the following billing cycle, three days before statement generation, and the existing cashback-credit process may take up to 60 days. Cashback is calculated after adjusting for refunds and reversals, and cashback relating to a later cancellation, refund or EMI conversion is reversed in the future. Uncredited or unused cashback is forfeited if the card is cancelled, converted or becomes delinquent. Preferred-partner value back is credited to the respective partner wallet after product delivery, can be used toward a subsequent purchase on the same partner platform, cannot be converted into Axis Bank cashback or statement credit, and has no specified validity period, redemption fee or minimum redemption.

faqs.question: How to convert my Axis Bank Select credit card purchases into EMIs?
faqs.answer: To convert your credit card purchases into EMIs, you can contact customer care or you can also do it easily via internet banking.

faqs.question: Will I need to submit a separate request to get my credit card's e-statement?
faqs.answer: No, you don't need to request the e-statement, but it will be sent to your registered email Id every month.

faqs.question: What is Club Vistara Gold Membership?
faqs.answer: Club Vistara Gold membership is one of the four tiers of Club Vistara. With the Gold membership, you earn additional 10 tier points per Rs. 100 you spend on making a reservation with Air Vistara. The card also offers many other benefits including priority check-in, guaranteed reservation in the Economy Class up to 48 hours prior, rescheduling fee waiver, priority baggage handling, 10 kg of additional baggage allowance, etc.

faqs.question: What is the validity of Club Vistara Points?
faqs.answer: Club Vistara Points are valid for a period of 36 months.

faqs.question: How can I redeem Club Vistara Points?
faqs.answer: Club Vistara Points are redeemable against award flights, class upgrades and also for booking any seat under the Cash + Points program.

faqs.question: What is Cash + Points program?
faqs.answer: Air Vistara's Cash + Points program allows you to redeem your CV points for booking any seat in any class. On redemption under this program, 1 CV Point = Re. 0.2.

faqs.question: Can I get an add-on credit card?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can provide your family members and even your children (provided they are 18 years or older) with add-on credit cards for no extra fee. The credit limit will be shared between the primary and the add-on card member.

faqs.question: How can I check the application status of my Axis Bank Vistara Infinite Credit Card?
faqs.answer: You can check the application status of your Vistara Infinite Credit Card via Axis Bank's official application tracking page or by contacting Axis Bank Credit Card customer care on 1860 419 5555. Other than this, you can also ask the bank officials about your credit card application status.

faqs.question: How to book ticket with Axis Bank Vistara Credit Card?
faqs.answer: You can easily book flight tickets using the Axis Bank Vistara Infinite Credit Card from the official website of Air Vistara. You can also book award flights using your earned CV Points and using the gift vouchers under the 'My Vouchers' section of your CV account.

faqs.question: How can I pay my Axis Bank Vistara Infinite Credit Card bill?
faqs.answer: You can pay the bill of your Axis Bank Vistara Infinite Credit Card using various methods, including Axis Bank internet banking, mobile banking, bill desk, and some card management apps like Cred.

summary: Flipkart pays 5% cashback and Cleartrip pays 5% cashback, each capped at Rs. 4,000 per statement quarter.
Myntra pays 7.5% cashback, capped at Rs. 4,000 per statement quarter. The Rs. 4,000 ceiling is per category, not shared across the three.

The preferred merchant list pays 4% cashback and covers FITPASS, Stepa by FITPASS, PVR, Swiggy and Uber. FITPASS and Stepa by FITPASS are not yet in this app's merchant list, so a spend at either is scored at the 1% base rate rather than 4%.
All other eligible spends pay 1% cashback.
No cashback is earned on utility and telecom, education, rent, wallet loads, government services, insurance, gold and jewellery, fuel, spends at financial institutions, cash advances or repayments.
Rent payments carry a 1% transaction fee, as do education payments made through third-party apps.
A 1% fee also applies once cumulative spends in a statement cycle cross ₹10,000 on wallet loads, ₹10,000 on online skill-based gaming, ₹25,000 on utilities or ₹50,000 on fuel.
International transactions carry a 3.5% foreign currency markup, and international transactions billed in rupees through dynamic currency conversion carry a 1.5% markup plus applicable taxes.
The card is issued as Visa Signature or Mastercard Platinum.

summary: Card variant: RuPay.

You earn 1 monie for every ₹1 you spend, on the card directly or through UPI, and 1% is what those monies are worth to a new cardholder. The value rises only as your monies balance grows: 1% up to a ₹3,00,000 balance, 1.5% from ₹3,00,001 to ₹5,00,000, and 2% above ₹5,00,000. The 3% figure needs two things at once, a monies balance of at least ₹5,00,000 and an average quarterly balance of at least ₹5,00,000 in your slice savings account measured from the previous 90 days of end-of-day balances. The app ranks this card at 1% because that is what almost everyone actually gets.
The "up to 3%" headline should not be treated as the card's normal base cashback rate. For most users starting out, the applicable redemption rate is 1% until the required monies balance grows.

Only a transaction of ₹2,000 or more can be converted to slice in 3, the current standard options are 2 months and 3 months, you must be eligible for slicing and have no unpaid dues from your latest statement to convert at all, and a transaction you do convert earns no monies. Closing one early costs 3.5% of the outstanding principal plus GST. The processing fee is ₹0.
International transactions earn no monies, even though the card charges no forex markup and no bank DCC markup.
Cash withdrawals earn no monies, and transferring money from your credit limit to a bank account costs 2.5% of the amount, minimum ₹25 plus GST.

Wallet loads, fuel, insurance, rent, education and government services earn no monies, and neither do taxes, online gaming and gambling, financial and non-financial institution transactions under the excluded MCCs, or agriculture transactions under the excluded MCCs.
This card carries no fuel-surcharge waiver. Fuel is charged 2% per transaction once cumulative applicable spending passes ₹25,000 in the statement cycle.

Some categories cost extra once you cross a threshold in the billing cycle: 2% on fuel and 1% on utilities once cumulative applicable spending passes ₹25,000, and 1% on rent above ₹10,000. Education and wallet loading are charged 1% from the first rupee. Each of these is a minimum of ₹10 plus GST.

The app cannot rank this card on its Spark offers: you have to activate each one yourself, they are personalised and they change, and many of them only pay if you pay through slice UPI rather than by an ordinary card transaction.
Source: slice UPI Credit Card — validated card document supplied by Siddhant, September 2026. No issuer URL is given in that document.

faqs.question: How to redeem HDFC Infinia Card reward points?

summary: 5% cashback is available only on the ten specified merchants: Amazon, BookMyShow, Cult.fit, Flipkart, Myntra, Sony LIV, Swiggy, Tata CLiQ, Uber and Zomato.
The 1,000 CashPoint monthly cap on the 5% rate is a single pool shared across all ten bonus merchants, not 1,000 CashPoints at each of them.
Other eligible spends earn 1% cashback, also capped at 1,000 CashPoints per calendar month.

A transaction at one of the ten bonus merchants that is billed under MCC 6540 is treated under the 1% category instead of the 5% category, so gift card, voucher and wallet load purchases at those merchants do not pay 5%.
Prepaid card, gift card and voucher purchases and wallet loads can earn the 1% cashback category, subject to the applicable terms.
Uber spends qualify for 5% only when the transaction is billed under MCC 4121; Uber charges billed under any other code fall to the 1% rate.

₹1 lakh of spends in a calendar quarter unlocks either a ₹1,000 brand voucher or 1 domestic lounge access. The quarterly milestone voucher can be taken from Amazon Pay, Flipkart, PVR, Pizza Hut, Pantaloons, BookMyShow, Uber, BigBasket or Lifestyle.
No CashPoints are earned on fuel, rent, government-related transactions, cash advances, EMI, Smart EMI or Dial-an-EMI conversions, card fees and other charges, or the payment of outstanding balances.
Education paid directly to a college or school website or at a POS machine earns the 1% rate, while education routed through a third-party app such as CRED, Paytm, CheQ or MobiKwik earns nothing.
The card is issued in four variants: Visa Signature, Mastercard World, RuPay Select and Diners Club International.
Source: HDFC Millennia Credit Card validated document supplied by Siddhant, 5 September 2026.

redemption.notes: 1 CashPoint is worth ₹1 as cashback against the statement balance, ₹0.30 on SmartBuy flight and hotel bookings, ₹0.30 as Airmiles, and up to ₹0.30 in the rewards catalogue. A minimum of 500 CashPoints is required for redemption against the statement balance. Cashback redemption is capped at 3,000 CashPoints per calendar month. Flight and hotel bookings can be paid up to 50% with CashPoints, with the remaining amount charged to the credit limit, and CashPoint redemption for flights and hotels is capped at 50,000 CashPoints per calendar month. On select vouchers and products, up to 70% of the value can be paid with CashPoints and the balance must be paid with the card. The rewards catalogue rate of ₹0.30 per CashPoint is an upper bound, not a fixed value. Unredeemed CashPoints expire after 2 years.

faqs.question: How to redeem HDFC Millennia CashPoints?

faqs.question: What is the limit on the HDFC Millennia Credit Card?

summary: The 10X tier pays 10 CashPoints per Rs. 200 at BigBasket, BookMyShow, OYO, Swiggy and Uber. At the Rs. 0.15 CashPoint redemption value that is 0.75% in value.

The 10X rate applies only to eligible non-EMI spends, and the 2,500 CashPoint monthly ceiling is shared across all five accelerated merchants together, which is Rs. 50,000 of eligible spend per calendar month.
Other eligible spends earn 1 CashPoint per Rs. 200, which is 0.075% in value at Rs. 0.15 a CashPoint.
CashPoints on this card are capped at 15,000 per statement cycle across every earning rule combined.
CashPoints accrue only on transactions of at least Rs. 200 and in whole multiples of Rs. 200, so the part of a spend below a full Rs. 200 step earns nothing.

Utility spends earn up to 2,000 CashPoints per calendar month (MCC 4900), telecom and cable up to 2,000 CashPoints per calendar month (MCC 4812, 4814 and 4899), and grocery up to 1,000 CashPoints per calendar month.
On the RuPay variant, eligible UPI spends earn 1 CashPoint per Rs. 200 up to 500 CashPoints per calendar month; fuel, wallet and prepaid card loads and voucher purchases do not earn on UPI.

Education paid directly on a college or school website or at a POS machine still earns CashPoints and is not charged the education fee; education paid through a third-party app earns nothing and attracts a 1% fee. The education MCCs are 8211, 8220, 8241, 8244, 8249 and 8299.

Fuel, rent, government payments, wallet and gift or prepaid card loads, voucher purchases, cash advances, payment of outstanding balances, card fees and other charges, EMI transactions, EasyEMI and SmartEMI or Dial-an-EMI transactions earn no CashPoints; the 1% fuel surcharge waiver is a separate benefit and still applies to those fuel spends.
The card is issued as Visa Platinum, Mastercard Platinum or RuPay Platinum.

Source: HDFC Freedom Credit Card, validated document supplied by Siddhant, September 2026 - https://www.hdfc.bank.in/content/dam/hdfcbankpws/in/en/personal-banking/discover-products/cards/credit-cards/freedom-credit-card/freedom-tncs.pdf

fuel.note: 1% fuel surcharge waiver on fuel transactions between Rs. 400 and Rs. 5,000, capped at Rs. 250 per statement cycle. Fuel spends themselves earn no CashPoints, and a consumer-card fuel transaction above Rs. 15,000 attracts a 1% fee on the entire transaction, capped at Rs. 3,000.

channels.note: Minimum 3,334 CashPoints, worth about ₹500. ₹50 fee per redemption. Up to 50,000 CashPoints per calendar month
CashPoints can pay up to 50% of the booking value; the balance is charged to the HDFC Bank credit card. Up to 50,000 CashPoints per calendar month
CashPoints can pay up to 70% of the value of selected products and vouchers. ₹99 plus applicable taxes per redemption

redemption.notes: One CashPoint is worth ₹0.15 on every published channel. Statement cashback needs a minimum of 3,334 CashPoints, worth about ₹500, and costs ₹50 per redemption. Redeeming from the rewards catalogue costs ₹99 plus applicable taxes, and CashPoints can cover at most 70% of a catalogue product or voucher. On SmartBuy flights and hotels CashPoints can cover at most 50% of the booking, with the balance charged to the card. Statement cashback and SmartBuy flight or hotel redemption each carry their own separate 50,000 CashPoint per calendar month ceiling. CashPoints expire 2 years after they are earned. The card's fourth stored channel, Airmiles, is not covered by Siddhant's redemption table and is left as it was.

summary: The card earns 2 Reward Points per ₹150 spent, which is the same as 1 Reward Point for every ₹75. A spend below ₹75 is carried forward to the next eligible transaction until the ₹75 threshold is reached.

Travel with Points, on the HSBC Rewards portal, pays 4X Reward Points on flights, 6X on hotels and 2X on car rentals. The bonus applies only to bookings routed through that portal, so the same flight, stay or car rental booked anywhere else earns the ordinary rate.
Accelerated Reward Points under Travel with Points are capped at 18,000 points per calendar month, counted across flights, hotels and car rentals together. Base Reward Points remain uncapped.

The Rewards Marketplace values 1 Reward Point at ₹0.50 and can be used for gift cards, merchandise and Apple Store products. The exact points required for an individual item are shown in the HSBC Mobile Banking app, and redemption values across the platform are dynamic.

The source document states two different values for a Reward Point: ₹0.50 in the Rewards Marketplace section, and ₹0.25 in the cons, which read 'Low base reward rate - only 0.33% at ₹0.25 per Reward Point'. KredMe ranks this card at ₹0.25 per point, the more conservative of the two, and records the ₹0.50 marketplace figure on the Rewards Marketplace redemption channel.
Air miles and hotel points are worth what the partner programme redeems them for. The transfer ratio on its own does not determine the value of an HSBC Reward Point.
British Airways, Qatar Airways and Singapore Airlines KrisFlyer all transfer at 2 Reward Points to 1 mile and are highlighted for their potential high-value redemptions.
Accor ALL is the standout hotel transfer partner because its redemption value is fixed: 2 HSBC Reward Points become 1 ALL Reward Point, and 2,000 ALL points are worth €40.
A 1% fuel surcharge waiver applies across India, capped at ₹250 per calendar month.
₹250 cashback is paid on contactless fuel purchases and requires ₹10,000 of fuel spending per quarter. Fuel transactions under the excluded fuel MCCs still earn no Reward Points.

Whole categories earn no Reward Points on this card, identified by merchant code: utilities (MCC 4900), tax payments (9311), real estate and property managers (6513), non-financial institutions (6051), money transfers (4829), jewellery (5944 and 5094), insurance (6300 and 5960), fuel (5541, 5983, 5172, 5542 and 5552), financial institutions (6011, 6012 and 6010), e-wallet loads (6540), bail and bond payments (9223), and education and government payments (9399, 8299, 8220, 8211, 8241, 8244, 8249, 9222, 9402, 9211 and 9405).
Cash advances, fees and charges, disputed transactions, balance transfers, annual fees, late payment charges and other non-sales transactions earn no Reward Points.
Reward Points expire three years after they are earned.
Source: validated card document for the HSBC Visa Platinum Credit Card (September 2026). The document supplied no issuer URL, so none is cited here.

Sometimes, your card is automatically pre-approved for a higher limit, in which case you can opt for a higher credit limit through ICICI internet banking or the iMobile Pay app.

fuel.note: 1% fuel-surcharge waiver at HPCL outlets on transactions of ₹400 to ₹4,000. On top of it, 4% cashback from ICICI Bank on eligible HPCL fuel, capped at ₹200 a month, and an additional 1.5% as 6 Happy Coins per ₹100 credited to the HP Pay wallet when the purchase is made through HP Pay. The three together are the headline 6.5%.

summary: The three parts of the headline 6.5% on HP Pay fuel are 4% cashback from ICICI Bank, a 1% fuel-surcharge waiver, and an additional 1.5% paid as 6 Happy Coins per ₹100 into the HP Pay wallet.
The ₹200 monthly ceiling on the 4% HPCL fuel cashback is reached at roughly ₹5,000 of HPCL fuel spending in that month.
The 4% fuel cashback applies at HPCL outlets even when another bank's POS terminal is used.
The 1% fuel-surcharge waiver applies to HPCL transactions between ₹400 and ₹4,000.

The daily-essentials benefit pays 20 ICICI Bank Reward Points per ₹100, capped at 400 Reward Points per statement cycle. That is a maximum reward value of ₹100 per statement cycle and is reached at about ₹2,000 of eligible spending.
The eligible daily-essential categories are grocery, utilities, telecom, government payments, tax payments and departmental stores.

The indicative MCCs for the daily-essentials rate in the current ICICI Bank MITC are, for utility and telecom, 4899, 4900, 4901, 3887, 4897, 5416, 5417, 4812, 4813, 4814, 4815, 4821, 4896, 4902 and 3886; for grocery and departmental stores, 3333, 5411, 5412, 5441, 9751, 5311, 5331 and 5499; and for government and tax, 6760, 9222, 9211, 9399, 9402, 9405, 9313 and 9311.
All other eligible spends earn 2 ICICI Bank Reward Points per ₹100, an indicative effective reward value of 0.5% using ₹0.25 per point.
Reward Points on insurance are earned only on the first ₹40,000 of spending per statement cycle, and on transportation only on the first ₹10,000.

On the RuPay variant, eligible merchant UPI transactions earn Reward Points at the rate for their category: an eligible daily-essential or departmental-store UPI transaction earns 20 points per ₹100, and any other eligible merchant UPI transaction earns 2 points per ₹100.
Fuel bought anywhere other than HPCL earns no Reward Points. HPCL fuel is rewarded as cashback rather than as Reward Points.

Rent and property-related transactions, wallet loads, cash withdrawals and quasi-cash transactions, EMI transactions, balance transfers, personal loans taken on the credit card, joining and annual fees, interest, late-payment charges and other card fees, and reversed or cancelled transactions all earn no rewards.

The indicative restricted-category MCCs are, for fuel, 1361, 3851, 5172, 5541, 5542, 5983, 9752 and 5555; for rent and property, 6513, 7014, 7407 and 5271; for wallet loads, 6540; and for cash and quasi-cash, 6010, 6011, 6050, 6051, 6529, 6530, 6538, 6541, 6542, 6666, 7777, 9999 and 3882.

Roadside assistance covers one registered vehicle for the primary cardholder and includes telephone assistance, minor on-site repair, flat-tyre help, battery jump-start and battery-replacement assistance, delivery of up to five litres of fuel with the fuel cost payable, towing after breakdown, accident or incorrect fuelling, spare-key delivery within the same city and within 50 km, and taxi base fare for up to 50 km after the vehicle is immobilised. It is available only after the joining or annual fee has been paid, and is unavailable for any year in which the annual fee is waived.
Spending ₹75,000 in the preceding calendar quarter unlocks one domestic airport lounge visit in the following calendar quarter, up to four visits a year, for the primary cardholder only.

Spending ₹25,000 in the preceding ICICI-defined spend quarter unlocks the BookMyShow and INOX movie offer in the following calendar quarter, on a minimum booking of two tickets, with a maximum discount of ₹100.

ICICI Bank charges 1% on rent, on any single fuel transaction above ₹10,000, on any single utility or transportation transaction above ₹50,000, on third-party education payments, and on wallet loads of ₹5,000 or more, and 2% on online skill-based gaming.
Railway bookings carry a fee of 1.8% for internet transactions and 2.5% for other bookings.
Dynamic currency conversion costs 3.5% on rupee transactions made at an international location or with an overseas-registered merchant, and refunds attract the same fee.
EMI charges are 2.99% capped at ₹299 plus GST for Instant EMI, up to 2% for EMI on Call, and up to 3% of the outstanding principal plus unbilled interest for pre-closure.

Source: ICICI Bank's card terms and current Most Important Terms and Conditions, as recorded in KredMe's validated card document for this card (September 2026). The document supplied no issuer URL, so none is cited here.

summary: Eligible MakeMyTrip hotel bookings earn 6 myCash per ₹100. Eligible MakeMyTrip flight, holiday-package, cab and bus bookings earn 3 myCash per ₹100. Other MakeMyTrip and retail spends earn 1 myCash per ₹100, an effective 1%.
Flat 25 myCash is earned on each eligible MakeMyTrip train booking, whatever the booking is worth.
Insurance spends earn 1% myCash, capped at 1,000 myCash per card-anniversary year, which corresponds to about ₹1,00,000 of eligible insurance spend a year.

The international lounge visit is delivered through the Priority Pass issued to the primary cardholder. Add-on cardholders are not eligible, and the card-specific terms set no separate spending requirement for international access.

From 1 July 2026 domestic lounge access is spend-gated: ₹75,000 of spend in the preceding ICICI-defined spend quarter unlocks two visits in the following calendar quarter, up to eight visits a year, for the primary cardholder only.

From 1 April 2026 the BookMyShow movie benefit is spend-gated: ₹25,000 in the preceding ICICI-defined spend quarter unlocks 25% off the second ticket capped at ₹150, once a month on the Mastercard and once a month on the RuPay card, for a maximum combined discount of ₹300 a month. Add-on cardholders must independently meet the spending requirement.

A ₹1,000 MakeMyTrip hotel voucher is issued within 45 business days of the annual fee being paid and is valid for three months. Spending ₹3 lakh to have the fee waived therefore also gives up the voucher.
Three-month no-cost EMI is available on eligible MakeMyTrip flight, hotel and holiday-package bookings, but EMI transactions themselves earn no myCash.

No myCash is earned on EMI transactions, balance transfers, Personal Loan on Credit Card, reversed transactions, joining and annual fees, late-payment and other card fees, or commercial, business and other non-personal spending.
On the RuPay variant, eligible merchant UPI transactions earn 1% myCash.
The card is issued as a Mastercard World and a RuPay Platinum together.

myCash is not earned on rent payments, wallet reloads, cash advances and transactions treated as cash advances, EMI transactions, balance transfers, Personal Loan on Credit Card, joining and annual fees, late-payment charges and other card fees, reversed transactions, or commercial, business and other non-personal spending.

The indicative restricted-category MCCs are rent and property 6513, 7014, 7407 and 5271; wallet loads 6540; and cash or quasi-cash 6010, 6011, 6050, 6051, 6529, 6530, 6538, 6541, 6542, 6666, 7777 and 9999.

Source: ICICI Bank MakeMyTrip Credit Card terms and conditions - https://www.icici.bank.in/content/dam/icicibank/india/managed-assets/revamp-page-images/docs/pdf/makemytrip-icici-credit-card-terms-and-conditions.pdf

renewal: ₹1,000 MakeMyTrip hotel voucher after payment of the annual fee, issued within 45 business days and valid for three months.

redemption.notes: 1 myCash = ₹1. myCash is credited to the primary cardholder's linked MakeMyTrip account and is redeemed on the MakeMyTrip website, mobile site or app. Up to 100% of a booking's value can be paid using card-earned myCash. Card-earned myCash does not expire while the card remains active. Siddhant's redemption list is introduced with the word "include", so it is not an exhaustive list; the existing partner-voucher channel is retained rather than deleted on the strength of an omission.

summary: 10 Reward Points per ₹200 are earned from the first eligible transaction on dining, travel, international spends and eligible birthday spends.
3 Reward Points per ₹200 are earned on other eligible spends.

1 Reward Point per ₹200 is earned on insurance, utility payments, railway spends and FASTag - the lowest rate on this card. FASTag is not a category the app can identify on its own, so a FASTag load may be shown at the card's ordinary rate.

The 10 Reward Points per ₹200 rate also covers spends made abroad, from the first eligible transaction. The app cannot tell where in the world a card is being used, so it shows this card at its standard rate on an international purchase.
Eligible birthday spends earn the same 10 Reward Points per ₹200. The app does not know your birthday, so it shows the standard rate on that day.
Hotels booked through the IDFC FIRST ecosystem earn 20% bonus Reward Points and flights earn 10% bonus, on top of the rate above. The same stay or ticket booked anywhere else earns no bonus.
Both the complimentary domestic and the complimentary international lounge visit are unlocked by ₹20,000 of eligible spending, and each is capped at one visit per quarter.
The complimentary golf round or lesson needs ₹20,000 of eligible spending in a billing cycle and is capped at one session per quarter, at participating golf courses.

₹20,000 spent in a calendar month unlocks the Buy 1 Get 1 movie benefit for the following month, up to 2 bookings a month with the discount on the second ticket capped at ₹250. The benefit is available through the applicable movie-booking platform.
The product guide also advertises ₹500 worth of vouchers for ₹5,000 of spending within 30 days of card generation.

Travel insurance covers loss of checked-in baggage, delay of checked-in baggage, loss of passport or documents, and flight delay. The card also carries a ₹1 crore air accident cover and complimentary roadside assistance up to ₹1,399.
The Visa Infinite version also provides airport meet & greet, airport transfers, concierge services and the Luxury Hotel Collection.
Fuel transactions, transactions converted into EMI, cash withdrawals, fees and charges, Loan on Card and balance transfers all earn no Reward Points.
1 Reward Point is worth ₹0.25 however you redeem it, including flights and hotels booked on the IDFC FIRST Rewards platform.

summary: Eligible retail spends earn 2 Reward Points per Rs. 100, which is 0.40% in value at the issuer's own Rs. 0.20 a point.

The extra 20% off, capped at Rs. 500 and usable 3 times per calendar month, applies only when the booking is made in the EazyDiner app, the restaurant is enrolled in the offer, and the bill is paid with this card through PayEazy.

The Buy 1 Get 1 movie offer runs through BookMyShow, is limited to one booking a month, caps the free second ticket at Rs. 200, and adds Rs. 50 off when the food and beverage option is selected.

Fuel transactions, fees and charges, cash advances, cash withdrawals, EMI transactions, balance transfers and any other transaction specifically excluded under the applicable Reward Point terms earn no Reward Points.

summary: Complimentary 12-month FITPASS PRO membership in the first year, subject to payment of the joining fee and at least one card transaction. Capped at 12 fitness sessions per month, a maximum of three sessions per week and one session per day, covering participating gyms and fitness studios, AI-led FITCOACH workouts and FITFEAST nutrition guidance. The voucher must be activated within 90 days.

Apollo rewards apply to eligible transactions through the Apollo 24|7 app and eligible Apollo Pharmacy stores, and eligibility depends on the merchant ID list Apollo supplies to SBI Card. Apollo Hospitals, Apollo Cradle, Apollo Spectra, airport pharmacies and certain corporate-hospital outlets may be excluded.

Apollo rewards are capped at 5,000 Reward Points per statement cycle, which is roughly ₹50,000 of eligible Apollo spending. The dining, movies, entertainment and travel tier carries its own separate 5,000 Reward Point cap, roughly ₹2,50,000 of eligible spending. Spending beyond either cap earns the base rate of 1 Reward Point per ₹200.

Reward Points must be converted into Apollo Health Credits to be used in the Apollo ecosystem. Health Credit value back generally requires an eligible purchase exceeding ₹100 and is calculated on the amount remaining after redeemed Health Credits are applied. Benefits can vary by product, category and customer.

No Reward Points are earned on balance transfers, cash advances and ATM withdrawals, Flexipay transactions, merchant EMI transactions, financial charges and transaction fees, transactions made before enrolment in the reward programme, or disputed, cancelled, reversed and refunded transactions.
Eligible Apollo diagnostic tests return up to 30% in combined value: 10 Reward Points per ₹100 spent plus up to 20% additional value back as Apollo Health Credits.
Eligible Apollo medicine purchases return up to 25% in combined value: 10 Reward Points per ₹100 spent plus up to 15% additional value back as Apollo Health Credits.
Other eligible Apollo spending earns 10 Reward Points per ₹100.
The 2 Reward Points per ₹100 tier covers dining MCCs 5812 and 5814, movies and entertainment MCCs 7832 and 7922, and travel MCCs 4511, 3020, 7011, 4112 and 4722.
Other eligible spends earn 1 Reward Point per ₹200, calculated only in complete ₹200 multiples. UPI transactions on the RuPay variant earn 1 Reward Point per ₹200.

The built-in Apollo Circle benefits include up to 50% discount on home sample-collection charges, one complimentary health test (HbA1c, CBC or TSH), up to ₹150 savings on eligible doctor consultations, free home delivery, accidental cover of ₹1 lakh and access to doctor consultations through Apollo 24|7.

One complimentary domestic airport lounge visit is available per calendar quarter, up to four visits a year. The complimentary Priority Pass membership runs for two years for the primary cardholder and includes no complimentary visits: cardholder and guest visits cost USD 27 plus applicable taxes per person per visit, posted 30 to 60 days after the visit.
The first-year complimentary FITPASS PRO membership runs for 12 months and requires payment of the joining fee and at least one card transaction.

The comprehensive health check-up milestone pays a check-up worth ₹1,999 for ₹50,000 of spending within 90 days of account opening or card anniversary. Eligibility is assessed after the 90-day period, the voucher is issued within 15 working days, and booking and testing must be completed within 90 days of voucher issuance.

The ₹6 lakh annual-spend milestone pays a Noise ColorFit Pulse 4 Pro smartwatch worth ₹7,999. The voucher is issued within 21 working days, is valid for six months, is valid only for the specified smartwatch and cannot be exchanged for cash.
The 1% fuel-surcharge waiver applies to eligible transactions of ₹500 to ₹4,000, subject to a maximum waiver of ₹100 per statement cycle, on fuel MCCs 5172, 5541, 5542 and 5983.
No Reward Points are earned on fuel (MCCs 5172, 5541, 5542, 5983), wallet loads (6540, 6541), rent (6513), government transactions (9311, 9399) or digital gaming (5816, 7993, 7994).
Card variant: RuPay Select / Mastercard Platinum.

summary: Eligible IRCTC train bookings earn 10 Travel Reward Points per ₹100 of eligible base fare on First AC, AC 2 Tier, AC 3 Tier, Executive Chair Car and AC Chair Car tickets booked through the IRCTC website or mobile app.

Reward Points on train bookings are calculated only on the eligible base fare; reservation, superfast, convenience and other charges are excluded. Points are credited five days after the journey, provided the ticket is not cancelled or modified.
The cardholder must be one of the passengers and must provide the linked 11-digit loyalty number. Rewards cover the primary cardholder and the co-travellers included in the booking.

IRCTC air tickets and e-catering earn 5 Reward Points per ₹125 spent, through air.irctc.co.in and ecatering.irctc.co.in only. Air-ticket earning is capped at 750 Reward Points per monthly statement cycle.

Dining and standing-instruction utility payments earn 3 Reward Points per ₹125 spent. The accelerated utility rate applies specifically to utility payments registered through standing instructions; a one-off utility bill paid on the card earns the ordinary base rate.
Other eligible spends earn 1 Reward Point per ₹125, and this applies to eligible domestic and international transactions.
IRCTC payment-gateway charges are waived at 1% on eligible train bookings and 1.8% on eligible air-ticket bookings through IRCTC. GST and other charges are excluded from the waiver.
Railway-lounge access gives eight complimentary visits per year, a maximum of two per calendar quarter, to the primary cardholder only, on presenting a valid eligible card and train ticket.
The fuel-surcharge waiver is 1% on transactions of ₹500 to ₹4,000, to a maximum of ₹250 per statement cycle.

Annual travel-spend milestones award 2,500 Reward Points at ₹50,000 of annual travel spending and a further 5,000 Reward Points at ₹1 lakh of annual travel spending, to a maximum milestone benefit of 7,500 Reward Points worth ₹7,500 per year. Both milestone thresholds are measured on eligible TRAVEL spending, which includes specified railway and travel-agent transactions, and not on total anniversary-year spending.
The card is issued on the Visa Signature and RuPay Select variants.
A 1% fee applies to the entire utility payment once cumulative utility spending crosses ₹50,000 in a billing cycle (MCC 4900); utility spends still earn Reward Points.

No Reward Points are earned on balance transfers, Encash transactions, cash advances and ATM withdrawals, Flexipay and Merchant EMI transactions, finance charges, transaction fees and other card charges, or on disputed, reversed, cancelled and refunded transactions.

No Reward Points are earned on cancelled, unused, forfeited or free railway tickets, on tickets booked using military warrants or similar vouchers, on railway bookings where the cardholder is not a passenger, or on railway bookings made without the linked loyalty number.
Fuel (MCCs 5172, 5541, 5542, 5983), wallet loads (MCCs 6540, 6541), rent and property-management transactions (MCCs 6513, 7349) and government transactions (MCCs 9311, 9399) earn no Reward Points.

channels.description: 1 Travel Reward Point = ₹1 toward eligible IRCTC train tickets. No separate redemption fee.
SBI Rewardz catalogue; Rs. 99 redemption fee per request.

redemption.notes: 1 Travel Reward Point = ₹1 toward eligible IRCTC train tickets. Points are transferred from SBI Card to the linked IRCTC loyalty account each month. Partial payment using points is not permitted, so the full ticket must be paid for in points; any point shortfall can be purchased for ₹1.50 plus taxes per point. There is no separate redemption fee on the IRCTC train-ticket channel; the ₹99 per-request redemption fee applies to the SBI Rewardz catalogue. If a reward ticket is cancelled before travel, 50% of the redeemed points are forfeited, in addition to applicable railway cancellation charges. Points earned during a membership year expire according to the programme's two-year membership-cycle rule.

Accelerated Reward Points are capped at 7,500 per calendar month across all of these categories together, which is roughly ₹75,000 of eligible spending. Spending beyond the cap earns the base 2 Reward Points per ₹100.
All other eligible domestic and international spending earns 2 Reward Points per ₹100.

The complimentary FITPASS PRO membership runs for 12 months and allows a maximum of 12 fitness sessions a month, no more than three in a week and one in a day, across participating gyms, fitness centres and classes, with AI-led coaching through FITCOACH and personalised nutrition guidance through FITFEAST. The voucher is issued within 21 working days and must be activated within 90 days. Renewal needs both the renewal fee and one transaction within 12 months of card renewal.

The Netmeds First membership adds 2% NMS Cash capped at ₹100 on each eligible prepaid medicine order, free delivery on eligible orders of ₹99 or more, an additional 10% discount on pathology tests capped at ₹100, six complimentary online doctor consultations and priority order processing. NMS Cash stays valid for 90 days.
Domestic airport lounge access is one complimentary visit per calendar quarter, a maximum of four visits a year.

The ₹1,500 Netmeds e-gift voucher earned on spending ₹4 lakh in an eligible card-membership year is valid for up to 12 months, can be used only once, forfeits any unused balance, and cannot be combined with another offer or discount.

The complimentary Priority Pass membership is for the primary cardholder and carries no complimentary lounge visits. Every visit, cardholder or guest, costs USD 27 plus applicable taxes per person, and the charge may be posted 60 to 120 days after the visit.

Insurance cover: fraud liability up to ₹1 lakh, loss of checked-in baggage up to ₹72,000, delayed checked-in baggage up to ₹7,500, loss of travel documents up to ₹12,500 and flight delay up to ₹7,500, each subject to the insurer's conditions and reporting requirements.

summary: The card benefit is 5% back as NeuCoins on Tata Neu and partner Tata brands. A further NeuPass reward can stack on top of it, but NeuPass is a separate Tata loyalty programme, so the app ranks this card on the 5% card benefit alone.

BigBasket bought directly earns 5% as a card benefit, capped at 2,000 NeuCoins a month, plus 0.25% through NeuPass. Bought through Tata Neu it earns the same 5% card benefit capped at 2,000 NeuCoins a month plus a 5% NeuPass reward capped at 750 NeuCoins a transaction, which is the headline 10% up to ₹40,000.

Croma bought directly earns an uncapped 5% card benefit plus 0.33% through NeuPass. Bought through Tata Neu it earns the same 5% plus a 5% NeuPass reward capped at 500 NeuCoins a transaction, which is the headline 10% up to ₹10,000.

Tata CLiQ, direct or offline, earns an uncapped 5% card benefit plus 0.4% through NeuPass on a direct purchase. Bought through Tata Neu it earns 5% plus a 5% NeuPass reward capped at 5,000 NeuCoins a transaction, which is the headline 10% up to ₹1,00,000.

Tata CLiQ Luxury, direct or offline, earns an uncapped 5% card benefit plus 0.25% through NeuPass on a direct purchase. Bought through Tata Neu it earns 5% plus a 5% NeuPass reward capped at 5,000 NeuCoins a transaction, which is the headline 10% up to ₹1,00,000.

Tata 1mg, direct or offline, earns an uncapped 5% card benefit plus 0.1% through NeuPass on a direct purchase. Bought through Tata Neu it earns 5% plus 5% NeuCoins under the applicable NeuPass terms, which is the headline 10% up to ₹20,000.
Westside, direct or offline, earns an uncapped 5% card benefit plus 0.1% through NeuPass on a direct purchase.

IHCL and Taj booked directly earn the 5% card benefit plus a NeuPass reward that depends on tier: 2% Member, 4% Copper, 5% Silver, 7% Gold and 8% Platinum. Booked through Tata Neu the total can reach 13% depending on tier, made up of the 5% card benefit plus 5% through an IHCL Silver Tier membership.

Air India and Air India Express booked directly earn the 5% card benefit plus a NeuPass reward that depends on badge: 2% Aviator, 4% Explorer, 6% Highflyer and 8% Jetsetter, for a total of up to 13% by tier. Booked through Tata Neu they earn an uncapped 5% card benefit plus the NeuPass reward for the applicable badge.

Titan and Tanishq, direct or offline, earn an uncapped 5% card benefit plus a NeuPass reward that depends on the applicable Titan badge and product category. Through Tata Neu the same 5% applies with no cap, plus the applicable NeuPass reward for the brand and badge.

Qmin, direct or offline, earns an uncapped 5% card benefit plus the applicable NeuPass reward. Through Tata Neu it earns the 5% card benefit plus the applicable NeuPass reward. Qmin has no merchant id in merchants.json, so the app cannot rank the card on it and it earns the 1.5% base there.
Utilities, insurance, and telecom and cable each earn 5% back, each capped at 2,000 NeuCoins a month.
Other eligible spends earn 1.5% back. On the RuPay variant, UPI transactions earn 1.5% back capped at 500 NeuCoins a month.
A utility transaction carries a 1.65% convenience fee, which cuts the effective value back on utilities from 5% to about 3.35%.

Spending ₹75,000 in the previous quarter unlocks two domestic lounge accesses in the following quarter, which is where the headline eight domestic accesses a year comes from. The requirement is waived for the first quarter after issuance.

NeuCoins are not earned on fuel (MCCs 5172, 5541, 5542, 5983), wallet loads (MCCs 6540, 6541), rent (MCC 6513), gift, prepaid card or voucher purchases, cash advances (MCC 6511), payments of outstanding balances, card fees and other charges, Flexipay and EMI transactions, government-related transactions (MCCs 9399, 9311) or education payments (MCCs 8211, 8220, 8241, 8244, 8249, 8299).
The card is issued as Visa Signature or RuPay Select. 1 NeuCoin = ₹1 in savings.

summary: The extra up to 5% back is a NeuPass benefit rather than a card benefit. It applies only to eligible category purchases made through the Tata Neu app or website, and the rate you actually get depends on your NeuPass tier and, for some brands, a separate brand badge or membership tier. Only the 2% is a guaranteed card benefit.

Monthly NeuCoin caps apply on the accelerated categories: 1,000 NeuCoins on grocery, and 2,000 NeuCoins each on insurance, on utility, and on telecom and cable. At 2% that is roughly ₹50,000 of grocery and ₹1,00,000 each of insurance, utility and telecom spend in a month.
On the RuPay variant, UPI spends earn 1% back capped at 500 NeuCoins per statement cycle, which is roughly ₹50,000 of UPI spend a cycle.
Card-earned NeuCoins are transferred to the linked NeuPass account within seven working days after the statement cycle, and fractional NeuCoins are rounded down to the nearest whole NeuCoin.

Extra charges apply on some spends: ₹199 plus applicable taxes per rent transaction; 1% of the entire utility payment once utility spends cross ₹50,000 in a billing cycle; 1% on third-party education payments, though direct payments through a school or college website or POS machine are exempt; and 1% on every wallet-load transaction above ₹1,000.

Dynamic currency conversion costs 3.5% on any transaction of ₹1,000 or more billed in rupees at an international merchant or at an India-based merchant registered overseas, and neither that fee nor the forex markup is reversed when a transaction is refunded.

No NeuCoins are earned on gift-card, prepaid-card or voucher purchases, on transactions made before you enrol in the reward programme, on Flexipay transactions, on cash advances, or on payments of card fees, other charges and outstanding balances.
The headline up to 7% is 2% as a card benefit plus up to 5% as a NeuPass benefit.

The 2% card benefit applies to eligible non-EMI spends on the Tata Neu app or website and at eligible partner Tata brands. 1 NeuCoin = ₹1 in savings. NeuCoins cannot be converted into cash, statement credit or cash advances, and the card-specific terms state no minimum redemption and no redemption fee.

redemption.notes: Redemption fee ₹100 plus GST per request. Flight bookings carry an additional ₹99 plus GST convenience fee; hotel bookings do not, which makes hotels the better of the two portal options. Statement credit, gift voucher and merchandise redemptions can each use a maximum of 50% of the available point balance, and gift vouchers are capped at ₹25,000 per calendar month. Air India Maharaja Club transfers convert 10 YES Rewardz Points into 1 Maharaja Point, need a minimum balance of 2,000 points, can take seven working days and cannot be reversed. Points expire three years from the date they are earned. Best options: YES Rewardz hotel bookings at up to ₹0.25 per point without the additional flight-booking fee; an Air India Maharaja Club transfer, potentially best but only for high-value flight redemptions; and statement credit as the simplest option.

summary: The 12% tier pays 24 CheQ Points per Rs.200 and covers CheQ's partnered brands - Amazon, Flipkart, Zomato, BigBasket and Apple products powered by Unicorn - plus CheQ Travel flight and hotel bookings and utility bills paid inside the CheQ App.
Utility bills earn the accelerated 12% rate only when the bill is paid through the CheQ App. A utility bill paid anywhere else falls back to the base rate.
The 12% rate on flights and hotels applies only when the booking is made through CheQ Travel; a flight or hotel booked elsewhere earns the 5% tier instead.

The 5% tier pays 10 CheQ Points per Rs.200 across selected categories including fast food restaurants, restaurants, online marketplaces, clothing, electronics, books, department stores, specialty retail, grocery, airlines, bus lines, travel agencies and hotels.
Books, specialty retail and bus lines have no matching category in this app, so spends in those three are scored at the 1% base rate even though CheQ pays 5% on them.
CheQ UPI pays 2.5%, which is 5 CheQ Points per Rs.200, and only when the transaction is made through the CheQ App. UPI transactions routed through third-party UPI apps earn nothing.
All other eligible spends pay 1%, which is 2 CheQ Points per Rs.200, and base rewards carry no monthly or annual cap.
A single reward cap of 12,000 CheQ Points per statement cycle applies collectively to the 12% and 5% accelerated categories. Once it is reached, spending continues to earn at the lower rate.
Transactions below Rs.200 earn no CheQ Points.

CheQ markets these tiers as 12% / 5% / 2.5% / 1%, which counts a CheQ Point at Rs.1. The same document's redemption table values a CheQ Point at Rs.0.50 on CheQ Travel and gift cards and Rs.0.25 on bill payments, so the rupee value the app calculates uses Rs.0.50.

The standard Visa Platinum and RuPay Platinum (virtual) cards are linked to the same credit account and share one credit limit, and both are lifetime free. CheQ also offers an LED-powered Visa variant carrying a one-time issuance fee of Rs.999 plus GST.

summary: You must pick two cashback categories inside the Roarbank app every calendar month. The picks reset on the 1st, and any spend made before you have chosen earns nothing.

The bank decides which categories are on offer and what each one pays, and both can change from month to month. The options it has listed include grocery, fuel, restaurants, conveyance and entertainment, and 20% is the ceiling, not a standing rate.
Cashback is paid only when the transaction's own MCC matches a category you selected, so a shop that looks like a selected category but is coded differently pays nothing.
Once you have picked, the categories normally cannot be changed until the following month. Customer support may change one only if you have not yet transacted in it.
Total cashback is capped at ₹2,500 per calendar month across both selected categories, and anything earned above the cap is neither credited nor carried forward.
An international purchase earns cashback only if its own MCC matches a category you selected, and there is no separate rate for it, so weigh any cashback against the 3.5% foreign-currency fee.

Gift cards, prepaid cards and other stored-value instruments never earn cashback, and the bank applies that regardless of the merchant's MCC. Wallet and prepaid-instrument loads, credit and debit card top-ups, and any intermediary used to make them are excluded as well.

The bank can refuse cashback on any transaction it judges inconsistent with genuine retail use. Its own examples are a fuel bill larger than a standard vehicle tank could hold, a grocery or restaurant bill too large to be a single retail purchase, and a payment routed through a merchant without a genuine purchase behind it. The bank says this list is illustrative and not exhaustive.

Rent (MCC 6513) carries a 1% fee, with no minimum spend stated. Fuel, wallet-load and utility spends carry a 1% fee once your cumulative monthly spend inside each of those MCC groups passes ₹5,000, and the bank's own terms do not say whether that 1% applies only above ₹5,000, only to the transaction that crosses ₹5,000, or to the whole month's spend in that group.

If a purchase is refunded or reversed the cashback is taken back, and if you have already withdrawn it and your remaining cashback balance is short, the bank may debit the difference from your credit limit.

Merchant UPI transactions follow the same selected-category and MCC rules as card transactions, with no separate UPI rate and no UPI-specific cap. Non-merchant UPI transfers are funded only from the linked savings balance and cannot draw on the credit limit.
When the linked savings balance covers a purchase it is auto-debited immediately and only the shortfall draws on the credit limit, and the cashback rate is identical either way.

This is a 2-in-1 product: the transaction is authorised through the card, and when the linked Roarbank savings account holds enough money the utilised card amount is auto-debited from savings straight away. Only when the savings balance is short does the purchase draw partly or wholly on the credit limit.

Standard EMI conversion is available on transactions of ₹2,000 or more that are not older than 90 days, over 2 to 24 months, with no processing fee and interest of 1% flat per month on the original principal. Foreclosure costs 2% of the outstanding principal plus GST, partial prepayment is not allowed, and gold, jewellery, gambling, cash withdrawals and money transfers cannot be converted.

Partner EMI is available on eligible purchases at participating merchants. It carries a ₹300 plus GST processing fee that is never refunded, interest of 0.7397% to 0.8928% flat per month depending on tenure, a stated APR of 16%, and a foreclosure fee of 2% of the outstanding principal plus GST. Merchant-funded discounts, cashback or subsidies may be recovered if you foreclose voluntarily.
This is a RuPay Credit Card on UPI. The exact RuPay tier is not established by the current official sources.
There is no fuel-surcharge waiver on this card.
Source: Roarbank Credit Card Most Important Terms and Conditions - https://theunitybank.com/docs/roarbank/roarbank-credit-card-most-important-terms-and-conditions.pdf
